'''Bhoenn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the start of the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Near the end of the undeclared conflict, Bhoenn was assigned to oversee [[75th Legion forward camp|Camp Lytle]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

Commander Bhoenn was present when crash survivor [[Myahh]] enlisted the aid of Republic agents to rescue the other survivors of the ''[[Endar Rebirth]]'' from the nearby [[Tularan Marsh]].<ref name="Operation Salvage" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bhoenn was first introduced as an NPC character in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. His role was in presenting the player character with the mission "Operation Salvage", where the player must rescue the surviving members of the ''Endar Rebirth'' from the Tularan Marsh region on Taris.<ref name="Operation Salvage" />
